name: Szentlőrinc (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Szentlőrinc: a blue shield with a white figure of Saint Lawrence, a yellow griffin crest and a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed SZENTLŐRINC.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentlőrinc arms with crest, wreath and scroll
